strongest_angle: How Anthropic and other AI companies are integrating virtual pixel pets like Buddy into coding assistants and workstations to make unattended tasks more engaging.

key_facts.fact: In April 2026, Anthropic added a virtual pet feature named Buddy into Claude Code to accompany users while writing code.
Desktamer offers pixel pets for Mac, Windows, and Linux across a selection of over 3,000 community-created pets.
Arol Wright reported on August 29, 2026, that desktop pets have found genuine utility by accompanying unattended AI coding agents.
